description: For moving estimate, this inspection checklist records packing, disassembly, labor, vehicle, valuation, storage, third-party services, exclusions, and estimate assumptions. Its supporting evidence includes inventory survey, item photos, access measurements, building rules, weight basis, and customer-declared value.

blocks.label: Moving Estimate Context

sections.guidance: Identify the moving estimate service, reviewed areas, crew, and customer.
sections.title: Service Visit Reference

blocks.guidance: Mark each moving estimate item after direct review.
items: Origin and destination access facts match the current survey
Inventory quantities and specialty items are reconciled
Stairs, elevators, parking, carries, and reservation needs are recorded
Packing, storage, valuation, and third-party services are identified
Customer exclusions and changed assumptions are conspicuous
Photos, dimensions, schedule constraints, and follow-up questions are linked
blocks.label: Moving Estimate Task and Area Checks

blocks.guidance: Use one moving estimate row for each reviewed area.

sections.guidance: Check completed moving estimate work by task, room, zone, or equipment.

subtitle: Moving Estimate Inspection Checklist: household move survey and estimate development using origin, packing, and inventory survey.
title: Moving Estimate Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during household move survey and estimate development when the moving estimate record must identify origin, destination, dates, access, stairs, elevators, parking, inventory, special items, and customer contacts. Complete the applicable handoff for accepted estimate, inventory acknowledgment, schedule reservation, access confirmations, change protocol, and move handoff.
